findings.description: At 0:00 the metal bowl contains only green olives. At 0:06 several dark/purple olive-shaped objects appear mixed into the bowl, but no on-screen action ever adds anything to this bowl (the person only pours from the small bowl into the jar during 0:00-0:04). The dark shapes could plausibly be shadows cast by the person's hands held directly over the bowl, so this may be a lighting artifact rather than a real change.
